$comment: THE ALUMNI ACCESS RULE (D42-D44, owner 2026-11-23): ITS CONSTANTS AND ITS CASES, RUN BY BOTH IMPLEMENTATIONS.
MiConnect decides with three expression policies (infrastructure/authentik/blueprints/45-consent.yaml:
the link step's reminder and block; 60-applications.yaml: the MiGallery / Le Cercle / MinoWiki gate). Canari's
sign-in handoff must answer the SAME question before it signs a person into those sites, and it cannot
ask MiConnect: authentik 2026.8 honours `check_access?for_user` for a superuser only and silently
answers for the caller otherwise - the reason the consent answer is also re-derived
from what its read-only account reads. Two implementations of one rule drift unless one table drives
both: core-service's spec runs every case below and asserts its constants equal `constants`;
infrastructure/authentik/test-consent-flow.py runs every case through the REAL flow and policy engine
(test-blueprints.sh hands it this file). Every constant has a case on each side of it, which is what
pins the blueprint literals to these values.
A case: `today` the Paris date; `promos` the entry years of the profile's cursus; `cursus`, when
present, the RAW `attributes.profile.cursus` both sides are given instead (a malformed entry is
ignored, a boolean is no year), `promos` then being what they must read from it; `posts`;
`alumni` the `attributes.alumni` read (null: never read); `accessGroup` membership of `acces-<app>`;
`linked` an Alumni user-source connection exists. Expected: `link` the D44 page the person meets
(none / reminder / required), `gate` whether MiGallery, Le Cercle and MinoWiki let them in.

cases.name: first year: nothing
1 September P+1: the reminder
past 1 February P+2 at launch: the grace
the grace ends: blocked
promo 2025 the day before the grace ends
promo 2025 on 1 February P+2 itself
promo 2026 on 31 August P+1
promo 2026 on 1 September P+1
promo 2026 on 31 January P+2, after the grace
promo 2026 on 1 February P+2, after the grace
a linked account meets no link step
no cursus: no link step, and no window
the EARLIEST cursus dates the link, ANY cursus opens the window
31 August P+5: the window's last day
1 September P+5: the window is closed
a cotisant read this calendar year admits
a cotisant read of last year does not
a non-cotisant read does not
a cotisant with no read date does not
a post admits after the window
a post admits with no cursus
the ALUMNI post admits
the acces-<app> group admits after the window
a boolean promo is no entry year
a cursus entry that is not an object is ignored
